state.paragraph: Based upon progress made in due diligence and the negotiations with Party B during the week of August 8, 2016, meetings of the Transaction Committee and Board were scheduled for August 12, 2016 in anticipation of reviewing final agreements and approving a transaction with Party B. On the morning of August 12, 2016, following a discussion between representatives of BMO and G&W in which G&W indicated it would be submitting a revised LOI, G&W submitted a revised LOI to acquire the Company for a price of $25.00 per share in cash, which excluded the previously proposed CVR, together with mark-ups of the merger agreement and the voting agreement. G&W's LOI further indicated that the offer would expire at 6:00 p.m. on the following day. Later that day, Simpson Thacher submitted a mark-up of the disclosure letter. Upon receipt of the revised LOI and related merger documents, Hinckley Allen and Simpson Thacher negotiated revisions to the merger agreement and disclosure letter. The Transaction Committee met at 10:30 a.m. on August 12, 2016, and reviewed the status of the negotiations and merger documents with both Party B and G&W. Following that discussion, the Transaction Committee directed representatives of BMO to inform Party B that another party had submitted a revised LOI at a higher price.

ledger_rows.Note: Preferred bidder named: continue diligence and talks with G&W and B, but prioritize B for its higher price and finish the merger agreement with B.
Out by 08/04: the Committee named only G&W and B as continuing, and E's confirmed $21.26 offer is never mentioned again.
Carried from #24; reaffirmed by returned draft: B's counsel sent a revised merger agreement as the Company moved to complete the agreement with B (#44). On-site diligence continued to 08/11.
Target told G&W it intended to sign with another bidder. G&W asked to continue diligence (on-site 08/10-11) toward a better offer; granted. On 08/11 G&W signalled a revised LOI.
G&W's legal counsel; first seen acting 08/10/2016.
All-cash revised LOI; CVR dropped; mark-ups of merger and voting agreements; offer expiring 6 p.m. next day. Physical diligence done 08/11; agreement signed that day, without financing condition.
At its 10:30 a.m. meeting, the Committee had BMO tell B that a higher revised LOI had arrived. In the afternoon, the Board had BMO ask B to raise its price.

bid.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a bidder submits, revises, confirms or reaffirms a priced proposal, indication of interest or offer for the company. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
